prompt: The most horrifying drowned abomination, standing full-length facing the viewer, impossibly tall and starved to bone, spine bent the wrong way, arms far too long with an extra elbow joint bending backward, knuckles dragging, fingers ending in long split black nails dripping blood. Its whole head is bound in a blood-soaked burlap sack stitched shut with rusted fishhooks and wire, blank and faceless. Its chest is torn open down the middle, ribs splayed outward like a vertical jaw of broken teeth, black water and blood pouring out. Grey-blue rotting drowned skin, deep gashes, rusted chains and hooks pierced through the flesh, torn rags, blood running down its legs to bare clawed feet. Realistic dark oil painting, smooth tonal shading, no outlines, lit harshly from below by warm lantern light, deep black shadow above. Whole figure in frame with margin all round. Plain flat solid magenta background, nothing else behind the subject.
